王建新努力地修炼。除了每天早起的巡逻，剩下的时间全泡在空间里，盘腿坐在河边，一遍一遍地运转功法。灵气在体内流转，从丹田到头顶，从头顶到脚底，一圈又一圈。炼气四层的瓶颈像一扇紧闭的门，他推了无数次，门就是不开。

但他不急。该来的总会来，水到渠成的事。

一个星期后，那天傍晚，王建新像往常一样盘腿坐在河边。灵气在体内运转了一个大周天，两个大周天，三个大周天……到第七个大周天的时候，丹田里忽然轰的一声。

门开了。

灵气像决了堤的洪水一样，从丹田涌出来，沿着经脉冲向全身。那些以前没打通的小经脉，一根一根地被冲开。灵气所到之处，暖洋洋的，像泡在温泉里。丹田里的灵气雾开始凝缩，从气态变成液态，一滴一滴的，像清晨的露水，汇聚在丹田深处。

炼气四层。

王建新没有睁眼，继续运转功法，引导这股新的灵气在体内循环。灵气在经脉里流淌，不再是以前那种轻飘飘的感觉，而是沉甸甸的，像水银一样，每流过一条经脉，都带来一种充实而有力的感觉。

不知过了多久，灵气终于平稳了。王建新睁开眼睛，长长地吐出一口气。

这次的变化还是蛮大的。

首先，灵力化液。体内灵气从气态压缩凝炼为液态，质量和密度截然不同。以前用灵力，像用一盆水泼出去，散而无力。现在不一样了，液态灵力凝实得像油，运用起来得心应手，想快就快，想慢就慢，想凝聚成一点就凝聚成一点。同时，灵力储存显著提升，丹田里能装的灵力比以前多了好几倍，为后续修炼和战斗打下了坚实的基础。

再一个，五感敏锐。视力和听力又大幅提升了。他坐在空间里，能看清河对岸羊群身上每一根羊毛的纹路，能听见远处大毛它们打闹时的喘息声，甚至能听见自己体内血液流动的声音。肉身也强化了，他握了握拳头，力量比炼气三层的时候又大了好几倍。他试着用指甲在手臂上划了一下——皮肤上只留下一道白印，连皮都没破。

“现在的肉身应该能扛住手枪子弹吧？”王建新想了想，但不敢试。怕疼。

寿命好像没有什么感觉。炼气三层的时候能活一百五十岁，现在应该更长，但他感觉不出来，反正是很久很久以后的事。

最关键的是灵力控制。如臂使指，能凝聚出稳定的灵力团，法力从穴位喷薄而出，瞬间形成可抵挡攻击的法力护罩。他试了一下，意念一动，一层淡金色的光罩从身体表面浮现出来，把他整个人罩在里面。光罩很薄，像一层肥皂泡，但摸上去很结实，有弹性。而且还能内视，看见自己的内脏、肌肉、骨骼、血液。这可比X光机厉害。

“以后可以保命了。”王建新收了护罩，心里踏实了不少。

之前的三个初级法术——火球术、风刃术、冰锥术——现在使用起来，威力更大了。他对着河边的一块石头放了一个火球，火球比之前大了一倍，温度更高，打在石头上，石头炸开了一个大洞，边缘被烧得发黑。风刃也更锋利了，一挥出去，面前的草齐刷刷地断了一片，切口平整得像刀割的。冰锥更尖锐，钉在树干上，直接穿透，周围的木头冻得发白。

身法更灵活了。他在空间里跑了几步，速度快得跟瞬移似的，几十米的距离，眨眼就到了。

别的再没有什么变化了，也没有再给什么新的功法。

王建新翻了翻脑海里的功法，还是炼气篇，没有筑基篇，没有金丹篇。算了，不给了就不给了，炼气四层已经够用了。

再下来就是空间的变化了。

空间终于扩大了。他从河边走到边缘，以前那片白茫茫的雾墙往后退了好远。他围着空间走了一圈，估算了一下，大概有五十亩左右，是原来的五倍。河还是那条河，但比以前宽了一些，水也深了一些。河对岸的草地和种植区都扩大了，空荡荡的，等着他种东西。他搭的小木桥也掉入河里了。

神识也达到了五十米。以前是十米，现在是五十米，翻了好几倍。五十米范围内的一切，不用看不用听，清清楚楚地映在脑海里。地上爬的蚂蚁，土里钻的蚯蚓，空气里飘的灰尘，全都逃不过他的感知。

“看来这就是炼气初期突破到中期带来的巨大变化。”

随着神识达到五十米，对王建新来说简直更好用了。瞬移的间距能达到五十米——以前是十米，现在五十米内任意瞬移。周身五十米内任意收取物品，不用手摸，意念一动就行。

“这要不当个大盗——不对，侠盗，也不对，侠客——都有点对不起自己了。”王建新站在空间里，看着这巨大的空间，很欣慰。终于不感觉拥挤了。

以前空间小，物资堆得满满当当的，连下脚的地方都快没了。现在一下子多了四十亩空地，宽敞多了。

“先巩固修为。”王建新没有急着种地，而是盘腿坐下来，继续运转功法。炼气四层的境界刚突破，还不稳定，得好好巩固。

不知修炼了多长时间。两天？三天？反正是境界已巩固。灵气在丹田里安安稳稳地盘着，液态的灵力像一池清水，平静而深邃。神识稳定在五十米，法术和身法也都熟练了。

“干活。”王建新站起来，拍了拍身上的土。

Wang Jianxin practiced hard.In addition to getting up early every day to patrol, the rest of the time is spent soaking in space, sitting cross-legged by the river, and running the exercises over and over again.The spiritual energy flows in the body, from the Dantian to the top of the head, from the top of the head to the soles of the feet, circle after circle.The bottleneck on the fourth level of Qi Refining was like a closed door. He pushed it countless times, but the door wouldn't open.

But he's in no hurry.What is supposed to come will always come, and it will happen naturally.

A week later, that evening, Wang Jianxin sat cross-legged by the river as usual.The spiritual energy circulated in the body for one great cycle, two great cycles, three great cycles... On the seventh great cycle, there was a sudden bang in the Dantian.

The door opened.

Like a flood that has burst a bank, spiritual energy surges out of the Dantian and pulses throughout the body along the meridians.The small meridians that had not been opened before were opened one by one.Wherever the spiritual energy goes, it feels warm, like soaking in a hot spring.The spiritual mist in the Dantian began to condense, changing from gaseous state to liquid state, drop by drop, like morning dew, gathering in the depths of the Dantian.

The fourth level of Qi refining.

Wang Jianxin did not open his eyes and continued to operate the technique, guiding this new spiritual energy to circulate in his body.The spiritual energy flowing in the meridians is no longer the light and airy feeling before, but heavy, like mercury. Every time it flows through a meridians, it brings a full and powerful feeling.

After an unknown amount of time, the aura finally stabilized.Wang Jianxin opened his eyes and let out a long breath.

The changes this time are quite big.

First, the spiritual power is transformed into liquid.The spiritual energy in the body is compressed and condensed from a gaseous state into a liquid state, with completely different quality and density.In the past, using spiritual power was like pouring it out with a basin of water, dispersing and powerless.It's different now. The liquid spiritual power is as solid as oil. It's easy to use. You can go as fast as you want, go as slow as you want, and condense it into a little bit when you want to.At the same time, the spiritual power storage has been significantly improved, and the spiritual power that can be stored in the Dantian is several times more than before, laying a solid foundation for subsequent training and combat.

Another one, the five senses are sharp.Vision and hearing have been greatly improved.Sitting in the space, he could clearly see the lines of every wool on the sheep on the other side of the river, hear the breathing sounds of the big sheep in the distance when they were fighting, and even hear the sound of blood flowing in his own body.His physical body was also strengthened. He clenched his fists, and his strength was several times greater than when he was at the third level of Qi Refining.He tried scratching his arm with his nails - only a white mark was left on the skin, without even breaking the skin.

"The current physical body should be able to withstand pistol bullets, right?" Wang Jianxin thought for a while, but did not dare to try.Afraid of pain.

Life seems to have no feeling.When he was at the third level of Qi refining, he could live to be one hundred and fifty years old. It should be longer now, but he couldn't feel it. Anyway, it would be a long, long time later.

The most critical thing is spiritual control.If you use your arms and fingers, you can condense a stable group of spiritual power, and mana spurts out from the acupuncture points, instantly forming a mana shield that can withstand attacks.He tried it, and with a thought, a layer of pale golden light emerged from the surface of his body, covering his entire body inside.The photomask is very thin, like a layer of soap bubbles, but feels strong and flexible.And he can also look inside and see his own internal organs, muscles, bones, and blood.This is more powerful than an X-ray machine.

"You can save your life in the future." Wang Jianxin put away the protective shield, feeling much more at ease.

The three previous primary spells - Fireball, Wind Blade, and Ice Cone - are now more powerful when used.He fired a fireball at a stone by the river. The fireball was twice as big and hotter than before. When it hit the stone, a big hole exploded in the stone, and the edges were burned black.The wind blade was also sharper. When it was swung out, a piece of grass in front of it was cut off, and the cut was as smooth as a knife.The ice pick was sharper, nailed to the trunk of the tree, and penetrated directly, making the surrounding wood turn white with the cold.

Shenfa is more flexible.He ran a few steps in space, as fast as teleporting. He reached a distance of tens of meters in the blink of an eye.

Nothing else has changed, and no new techniques have been given.

Wang Jianxin looked through the exercises in his mind, and found that there was still a Qi-refining chapter, no foundation-building chapter, and no golden elixir chapter.Forget it, if you don’t want to give it, I won’t give it to you. The fourth level of Qi Refining is enough.

Next comes the change of space.

The space has finally expanded.He walked from the river to the edge, and the white wall of fog receded a long way.He walked around the space and estimated that it was about fifty acres, five times the original size.The river is still the same river, but it is wider and deeper than before.The meadows and planting areas on the other side of the river were expanded and empty, waiting for him to plant something.The small wooden bridge he built also fell into the river.

The consciousness also reached fifty meters.It used to be ten meters, but now it's fifty meters, which has doubled several times.Everything within fifty meters is clearly reflected in my mind without seeing or hearing.The ants crawling on the ground, the earthworms burrowing in the soil, and the dust floating in the air could not escape his perception.

"It seems that this is the huge change brought about by the breakthrough from the early stage of Qi refining to the middle stage."

As the consciousness reaches fifty meters, it becomes even more useful for Wang Jianxin.The teleportation distance can reach fifty meters - it used to be ten meters, but now you can teleport anywhere within fifty meters.Collect any item within fifty meters around you without touching it with your hands, just move your mind.

"Whether it's a big thief - no, a grand thief, or a knight - I feel sorry for myself." Wang Jianxin stood in the space, looking at the huge space, very pleased.Finally it doesn't feel crowded anymore.

In the past, the space was small, and supplies were piled up so much that there was almost no room to step down.Now there are forty acres of open space, which is much more spacious.

"Consolidate your cultivation first." Wang Jianxin did not rush to farm, but sat down cross-legged and continued to operate the technique.The realm of the fourth level of Qi refining has just been broken through, and it is not yet stable, so it needs to be consolidated.

I don’t know how long I have been practicing.Two days?Three days?Anyway, the realm has been consolidated.The spiritual energy is coiled safely in the Dantian, and the liquid spiritual energy is like a pool of clear water, calm and deep.His spiritual consciousness is stable at fifty meters, and he has become proficient in spells and body movements.

"Work." Wang Jianxin stood up and patted the dirt on his body.
